question: Chandrayaan–1, India's first spacecraft mission to the moon, was successfully launched by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**PSLV–C11**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **PSLV–C11** is a version of India's Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV).
 
• Chandrayaan–1, India's first lunar probe, was launched successfully by PSLV–C11 on **22 October 2008**.
 
• PSLV–C11 was developed by the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)**.
 
• This mission marked India's entry into lunar exploration and demonstrated its capability to launch and manage complex missions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **GSLV (Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle)**

 
 
• GSLV is another type of launch vehicle developed by ISRO designed to launch heavier payloads into geostationary orbits.
 
• It is used primarily for deploying communication satellites.
 
 
 
• **GSLV Mk III**
 
 
• GSLV Mk III, also known as LVM3, is the heaviest and most powerful rocket developed by ISRO.
 
• It is capable of carrying large payloads and was used for the Chandrayaan–2 mission.
 
 
 
• **RLV–TD (Reusable Launch Vehicle-Technology Demonstrator)**
 
 
• RLV–TD is an experimental project by ISRO to develop technologies for a reusable space launch vehicle.
 
• The aim is to reduce the cost of access to space.
 
 
 
• **Chandrayaan–1**
 
 
• Chandrayaan–1 was India's first mission to the moon and aimed at high-resolution remote sensing of the lunar surface.
 
• The mission was instrumental in confirming the presence of water/hydroxyl on the moon.
